name: The Ethicist
lens: Would this still be fair if everyone did it? Treats people as ends, not means.

name: The Builder
lens: Unit costs, supply, and whether it survives being done ten thousand times.

name: The Inventor
lens: Pushes for the bolder version and asks what the idea becomes in ten years.

name: The Skeptic
lens: Inverts: how would this fail? Looks for incentives and second-order effects.

name: The Analyst
lens: Separates what the system can actually do from what people hope it does.
